name: engagement-report
title: Engagement report draft
for_each: select id,name from engagements order by name

sections.title: Testing evidence
sections.sql: select name,criteria,procedure,preparer,result,evidence,conclusion,reviewer,reviewed_at from workpapers where engagement_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select name,severity,condition,cause,recommendation from findings where engagement_id=$1 order by name

sections.title: Management action plans
sections.sql: select a.name,a.owner,a.due,a.state,a.implementation_evidence,a.verification_evidence,a.verified_by from actions a join findings f on f.id=a.finding_id where f.engagement_id=$1 order by a.due,a.name
sections.note: Private draft. Review completeness, recipients and approval before issuing. Nothing is sent.

name: action-letter
title: Management action follow-up draft
for_each: select id,name from findings order by name

sections.title: Finding
sections.sql: select name,severity,condition,recommendation from findings where id=$1

sections.title: Agreed actions and verification
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,state,delay_reason,implementation_evidence,verification_evidence,verified_by from actions where finding_id=$1 order by due,name
sections.note: Do not treat a management implementation claim as independent verification. Draft only.
